proof_boundary: This hierarchy does not prove an L2 residual, RH, or Lambda<=0. It composes published Suzuki identities and Hardy-space machinery with the internally audited fixed-shift phase theorem; independent expert review is required.

rows.proof_boundary: Definition and the xi functional equation only.
rows.statement: Q_omega(z)=xi(1/2+z-omega)/xi(1/2+z+omega), with Q_omega(0)=1 for 0<omega<1/2.

rows.proof_boundary: Published Suzuki identity; no contour crosses a quotient pole.
rows.statement: The Laplace transform of H_(omega,k)(exp(t)) is Q_omega(z)/z^k, initially for Re(z)>1/2+omega.

rows.proof_boundary: A local Taylor definition at the zero-free real point z=0.
rows.statement: Write Q_omega(z)=sum_(j>=0)q_(omega,j)z^j locally and T_(omega,k-1)(z)=sum_(j=0)^(k-1)q_(omega,j)z^j.

rows.proof_boundary: The inverse Laplace image of T_(omega,k-1)(z)/z^k.
rows.statement: P_(omega,k)(t)=sum_(j=0)^(k-1)q_(omega,j)*t^(k-1-j)/(k-1-j)!.

rows.proof_boundary: Exact subtraction identity only.
rows.statement: For r_(omega,k)(t)=H_(omega,k)(exp(t))-P_(omega,k)(t), Laplace(r)=[Q_omega-T_(omega,k-1)]/z^k in the initial right half-plane.

rows.proof_boundary: Standard L2 Paley-Wiener theorem.
rows.statement: If r_(omega,k) belongs to L2(0,infinity), its Laplace transform belongs to H2 of the right half-plane.

rows.proof_boundary: Uses transform uniqueness from the common initial half-plane.
rows.statement: The H2 continuation in sl2_06 gives Q_omega=T_(omega,k-1)+z^k Laplace(r), so Q_omega has no poles in Re(z)>0.

rows.proof_boundary: The xi-specific growth input is essential.
rows.statement: For the xi quotient, pole-freeness in Re(z)>0 plus boundary unimodularity, Suzuki's high-strip estimate, and Phragmen-Lindelof imply that Q_omega is inner.

rows.proof_boundary: Requires innerness, not boundary modulus one alone.
rows.statement: If Q_omega is inner, [Q_omega-T_(omega,k-1)]/z^k belongs to H2: Taylor cancellation controls z=0 and the boundary tail is O(1/|t|).

rows.proof_boundary: Standard half-plane Hardy/Laplace correspondence.
rows.statement: Paley-Wiener and Laplace uniqueness turn the H2 function in sl2_09 into the actual residual r_(omega,k) in L2.

rows.proof_boundary: Internally audited composition requiring independent review.
rows.statement: For every fixed omega and k>=1, r_(omega,k) in L2(0,infinity) iff Q_omega is inner iff D(omega).

rows.proof_boundary: Uses the corpus fixed-omega phase theorem and cofinality.
rows.statement: If omega_j tends to zero and one residual r_(omega_j,k_j) is L2 for every j, then RH.

rows.proof_boundary: Conditional direction only; it cannot establish RH.
rows.statement: Under RH, Q_omega is inner and every residual r_(omega,k) is L2 for every fixed omega and k>=1.

rows.proof_boundary: New cofinal sharpening of Suzuki's published L2 criterion.
rows.statement: RH iff there are omega_j->0 and integers k_j>=1 such that H_(omega_j,k_j)(exp(t))-P_(omega_j,k_j)(t) belongs to L2(0,infinity) for every j.

rows.proof_boundary: Uses the exact Jordan-error kernel reduction.
rows.statement: The same residual equals x^(-1/2) integral_0^1 E_omega(xu)W_(omega,k)(u)du/u-P_(omega,k)(log x).

rows.proof_boundary: Exact level-one specialization only.
rows.statement: At k=1, P_(omega,1)=1, so the criterion is integral_1^infinity |H_(omega,1)(x)-1|^2 dx/x<infinity.

rows.proof_boundary: Exact residue-polynomial and antiderivative identities, not an unconditional decay estimate.
rows.statement: At k=2, q_(omega,1)=-2 xi'(1/2+omega)/xi(1/2+omega), so P_(omega,2)(t)=t+q_(omega,1) and r_(omega,2)(t)=-q_(omega,1)+integral_0^t (H_(omega,1)(exp(u))-1)du. Higher levels use the same central Taylor recursion.

rows.proof_boundary: Boundary energy cannot replace half-plane analyticity or positive-time Hardy support.
rows.statement: Q_bad(z)=(a+z)/(a-z) has modulus one on the imaginary axis and its regularized boundary trace is L2, but it has a pole at z=a. The boundary inverse Fourier transform is anti-causal, while the actual positive-time residual contains exp(a t) and is not L2.

rows.proof_boundary: Cofinality in omega remains indispensable.
rows.statement: An L2 residual at one fixed omega proves only D(omega); exact horizontal zero cancellation can still hide off-line zeros.

rows.proof_boundary: Finite energy samples remain nonpromotable evidence.
rows.statement: A finite numerical integral of |r_(omega,k)|^2 cannot certify integrability on the unbounded half-line.

rows.proof_boundary: The similar smoothing vocabulary does not identify the two kernels or remove the open arithmetic gate.
rows.statement: Classical smoothed-totient Riesz means retain a residue main term and obtain square-root bounds only under RH and extra zero-derivative hypotheses; they do not prove the Suzuki L2 premise.

rows.proof_boundary: This is an RH-strength obligation and remains open.
rows.statement: For one explicit omega_j->0 and convenient k_j, prove the Jordan-error residual in sl2_15 is in L2(dx/x) by direct arithmetic estimates without assuming a zero-free region.
